name: Member Of Group
description: A user is a direct member of a group with a role. Inherited membership is derived by walking NESTS_SUBGROUP, never stored.

role.description: The role granted, by GitLab's name for it.

access_level.description: GitLab's numeric access level (0 no access, 5 minimal, 10 guest, 15 planner, 20 reporter, 25 security manager, 30 developer, 40 maintainer, 50 owner).

expires_at.description: When the grant expires (ISO 8601). Absent when the grant does not expire or was not observed.
